job.title: Manager, Content Strategy
job.description:
Duration: 12 months to start

Job Description
  • The Manager of Content Orchestration & Personalization owns the structural foundation that makes content strategy actionable at scale.
  • This role is responsible for designing, governing, and stewarding the enterprise content taxonomy, metadata schema, and CMS governance framework that ensures the client's content ecosystem is organized, discoverable and built for personalized delivery at scale.
  • This role builds the enablement layer at the intersection of content strategy and systems design, ensuring every asset is properly classified, mapped to health topics, audience segments and journey stages and ready to reach the right customer in the right moment in their health journey.
WHAT IS EXPECTED (Essential Functions)
List the top responsibilities of an incumbent in this role in order of importance, most essential at top.
  • Design, build, and maintain the enterprise content taxonomy within Sitecore including tag hierarchy and metadata schema standards and enforce consistent governance across all digital content assets in the CMS and DAM
  • Own the content-to-personalization mapping within Sitecore Personalize, defining which content assets surface to which audience segments under what behavioral or demographic conditions, in partnership with the Platform, Engagement and Web teams
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for content requests from the digital product team, owning the intake triage process, scoping requests against team capacity and strategic priorities
  • Partner with content strategy to ensure personalization requirements and taxonomy considerations are integrated into content briefs at the planning stage, not retrofitted after production is complete
  • Train and conduct ongoing audits of the web and editorial teams on tagging standards and metadata governance expectations to maintain content quality, searchability, and downstream personalization accuracy
  • Partner with IT/Digital Platform on CMS configuration decisions that affect content team workflow, representing editorial and personalization requirements in technical planning conversations
  • Coordinate with web and SEO leadership to ensure content taxonomy and information architecture are aligned across content strategy, web governance, and organic discoverability infrastructure
  • Maintain governance documentation including content type definitions, field-level tagging guidance, lifecycle rules, and CMS usage standards; run a regular cross-functional taxonomy review cadence with marketing, clinical, and digital product stakeholders
  • Build a living content inventory mapped to active personalization use cases, identify gaps and redundancies, and report regularly on intake volume, request cycle time, and personalization coverage across key audience segments
  • Performs other position appropriate duties as required in a competent, professional and courteous manner.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, and ABILITIES
  • Direct, hands-on experience designing and governing content taxonomies and metadata schemas within an enterprise CMS—Sitecore, Adobe Experience Manager, Drupal, or equivalent digital experience platform
  • Ability to translate editorial content strategy into structured content models and governance frameworks, with a clear understanding of how taxonomy and metadata quality enable personalization, search, and AI-assisted content workflows downstream
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable navigating competing priorities across clinical, marketing, technology, and digital product teams, and able to make and enforce governance decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Working knowledge of Sitecore AI and Sitecore Personalize or similar is preferred; familiarity with audience segmentation logic, personalization rule configuration, and content targeting frameworks a strong plus
  • Detail-oriented systems thinker with the ability to hold both the structural logic of a content architecture and the editorial purpose it serves, translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively
  • Demonstrated ability to build processes, documentation, and governance frameworks in a newly created or evolving function, operating with autonomy and clarity in an environment without established precedents
  • Familiarity with health system content environments, including medical accuracy requirements, compliance considerations and governance across a multi-site, multi-brand digital ecosystem is preferred
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • EDUCATION: Bachelor's or 6+ additional years of relevant experience
  • EXPERIENCE: 5 years of relevant experience
  • CERTIFCATION/LICENSE/REGISTRATION (please detail):
  • PATIENT CARE: Non-Clinical
  • Other (please detail): Hands-on experience with Sitecore or equivalent CMS preferred; background in UX, information architecture or content design is a plus; health system or regulated industry experience is preferred

Position Summary
The Technical Operations Lead will work for the Solution Technical Lead and Deputy Program Manager to oversee and coordinate the adoption of the future state operational protocols. The Technical Operations Lead will join the technical leadership team which includes: Solution Technical Lead, Phase 2 Technical Lead,  Technical Testing and Quality Assurance Lead, Technical Security Lead, and Technical Reporting Lead. The Technical Operations Lead will:
  • Align with Comptroller Technical Group (CTG) leadership, Organizational leadership, Sponsor Organization technical leadership, Architecture Review Board (ARB), and Phase 2 Technical Lead to establish a future operations framework and operational model and define future state solution operational roles and responsibilities for the technical adoption and operational execution of the Phase 2 business solution.
  • Engage Commonwealth Department Information Technology (IT) organizations or IT representatives that support approximately 160 departments to ensure the future operational solution will be implemented within departments, operate as desired as defined by the business, and will support local department operational and compliance needs. This position will be accountable to communicate and facilitate with the IT department representatives on their local technology needs, track and manage local department IT needs / issues, facilitate overall department testing of business solution, verify department users have necessary access, manage approvals for department implementations, align with security and risk teams to ensure appropriate and proper access levels are enabled, and be the contact to oversee the local resolution to department operational issues.

      • For local full adoption of the new solution:
        • existing system shutdown and retirement plans, existing system data conversion plans, user security migration plans, and other
      • For local retention of existing system (full or part) aligned with the new solution:
        • data integration plans, compliance plans, or other.

  • Work side by side with Comptroller Technical Group (CTG) leadership, Commonwealth staff, solution SI, and solution SaaS vendor to establish the overall operational solution model, to identify and recommend future state operational needs, recommend future state roles and responsibilities, and will be responsible for oversight of specific operational deliverables provided by the SI and Product vendors during the project period with transition planning to CMW staff post go-live and warranty period.

    • Establish appropriate monitoring functions and operational SLAs to ensure a quality operational environment, including operational support tasks, local IT operational support tasks, alignment of data backups, and other related tools.
    • Assist Compliance team in implementing the procedures to meet risk mitigation requirements and to monitor vendor compliance with security protocols.
    • Maintain awareness and communicate status of data within each environment

job.title: Applications Security Consultant
job.description:
Duration: 3 months to start

Job Description:
Job Summary:
The organization is seeking an Application Security Consultant to join the greater Information Security Team and help advance our enterprise application security program. This role will play a critical part in the design, build, and operation of security capabilities that protect the organization’s web, mobile, and cloud-native applications. The position requires broad application security experience across secure development practices, code analysis, cloud security, and production protection technologies.

As a member of the Cybersecurity Team, the consultant will execute and mature the application security architecture and framework across development, cloud, and production environments. The position will work directly with business application teams on secure design, code review oversight, release coordination, and production resilience. This role will formally represent the application security team in discussions involving new projects, architectures, and security control design, ensuring cybersecurity requirements are embedded early and consistently. Regular interaction with both technical and business personnel will be required to provide risk-based security analysis and recommendations that balance protection, performance, and delivery timelines.

The consultant will administer and optimize static code scanning solutions such as Checkmarx, ensure vulnerabilities are identified and remediated in alignment with OWASP Top Ten and broader industry risks, and collaborate closely with AWS engineering teams to secure Lambda functions and runtime resources. The role will also partner with change and release management to coordinate production code deployments from both security and reliability perspectives, while maintaining operational oversight of application-layer protection technologies.

Essential Job Functions:
  • Lead application security design and implementation across web, mobile, and AWS cloud-native services, including secure architecture reviews, AWS Lambda and runtime resource protection, and integration of security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Administer and optimize static code scanning solutions such as Checkmarx, conduct vulnerability triage and remediation guidance aligned with OWASP Top Ten and broader application security risks, and validate security readiness prior to production release.
  • Manage and enhance application-layer protection technologies, including policy tuning, configuration updates, and detection improvements, ensuring protections remain effective without impacting performance or customer experience.
  • Coordinate closely with change and release management to align security controls with production deployment schedules, participate in go-live planning, and act in a Site Reliability Engineering capacity to ensure secure and stable releases.
  • Represent the application security team in project planning and architectural discussions, provide risk-based security analysis, and ensure cybersecurity requirements are embedded into design, development, and delivery decisions.
  • Provide structured security reporting, track remediation efforts, and support cross-functional project management activities to ensure application security initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with business objectives.

Non-Essential Job Functions:
  • These are functions which are ancillary to the job, and may be assigned to others if necessary. Most functions that account for only a small part of the job are considered non-essential.
  • Represent application security and cybersecurity in meetings or project discussions when additional coverage or subject matter expertise is needed.
  • Devise methods to automate security testing activities or streamline operational processes, where applicable.
  • Improve and document operational and troubleshooting procedures to support long-term maintainability.
  • Perform or support activities such as penetration testing, secure code reviews, or developer training when specialized coverage is needed, but not as a primary responsibility.

Minimum Requirements and Qualifications:
  • 3+ years of offense and defense application security experience with demonstrated hands-on expertise in SAST and SCA tools such as Checkmarx and Synk, including findings triage, ruleset tuning, and managing vulnerability lifecycle across enterprise environments
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top Ten and broader web and API vulnerabilities, including practical remediation techniques within enterprise environments
  • Knowledge of web and mobile application development and deployment methodologies
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS cloud environments, including Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, and S3, with experience operating cloud-native security platforms such as Orca Security, Wiz, or Prisma Cloud to surface and remediate risk across workloads and infrastructure
  • Ability to read and reason about code in languages such as Node.js, JavaScript, Java, or Python. Ability to sufficiently perform meaningful secure code review, validate SAST/SCA findings, and collaborate credibly with engineering teams on remediation
  • Experience working with change management and release governance processes within production environments
  • Strong project management and communication skills with the ability to represent cybersecurity requirements across technical and business stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipeline integration
  • Familiarity with security threat intelligence sources and how they inform application-layer defenses
  • Experience partnering with development teams to drive security remediation by running working sessions, building runbooks, and supporting secure coding adoption through a developer-first engagement model.
